#!/bin/bash
# give the debug container SYS_ADMIN and SYS_PTRACE by editing its spec, then runc exec
sudo python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p = '/tmp/bench79297389/.bench/debug/config.json'
c = json.load(open(p))
for k in ('bounding', 'effective', 'permitted', 'inheritable', 'ambient'):
    c['process']['capabilities'][k] += ['CAP_SYS_ADMIN', 'CAP_SYS_PTRACE']
json.dump(c, open(p, 'w'))
PY
sudo /tmp/bench79297389/node-debug runc --root /run/containerd/runc/k8s.io exec --user 0:0 bench79297389-app /usr/bin/maintain

#!/bin/bash
# replace the workload by a root one that runs the program

sudo ctr -n k8s.io tasks delete bench79297389-app; sudo ctr -n k8s.io containers rm bench79297389-app
sudo /tmp/bench79297389/node-debug ctr -n k8s.io run --rm --user 0:0 --mount type=bind,src=/tmp/bench79297389/data,dst=/data,options=rbind:rw docker.io/library/bench79297389-app:latest bench79297389-app /usr/bin/maintain
